raw_context:
Medhold Medical
is an established distributor of hospital-grade patient monitoring systems and medical capital equipment in Southern Africa
, rather than a direct consumer manufacturer of smartwatches, wearable ECGs, or continuous glucose monitors (CGMs). Consumer health tools like CGMs and wearable ECG watches are instead produced by major tech and medical device brands.
Crunchbase
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs)
Small sub-dermal sensors applied to the arm or abdomen
Measures glucose levels in interstitial fluid every 1 to 5 minutes
Popular options include the Abbott FreeStyle Libre and Dexcom G7
OneTouch
Smartwatches & Wearable ECG
Wrist-based devices tracking electrical heart rhythms and vital signs
Models like the Apple Watch, Samsung Galaxy Watch, and Fitbit Sense feature FDA-cleared ECG apps
Wrist blood glucose tracking on consumer smartwatches remains largely experimental or non-clinical
Amazon.in
Sleep Trackers & Remote Patient Monitoring
Sleep trackers:
Rings, bands, or mattress pads monitoring sleep stages and heart rate variability
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):
Clinical systems used by providers to track patient vitals from home via cellular or Bluetooth equipment
